method: train-only multiscale log-red-chromaticity residual statistics; no neural training

source.title: The Dresden Surgical Anatomy Dataset for abdominal organ segmentation in surgical data science
source.authors: Carstens, Rinner, Bodenstedt, Jenke, Weitz, Distler, Speidel and Kolbinger
source.license: CC-BY-4.0 per original Figshare and official HF metadata
source.qualification: Paper Usage Notes also say non-commercial. This discrepancy is preserved; no legal clearance is claimed.
source.rendition: Official viewer JPEG, not lossless original
source.changes: Glare/shadow exclusion, coarse illumination removal, statistical fit of residual bands and marginal distribution, randomized synthesis. No source pixel layouts or camera highlights are copied.

limitations: Tiny statistical pilot; only one fit and one held-out film region.
Film thickness, anatomical support, physical scale and wetness are authored.
No neural model retraining, measured BRDF, active bleeding or clinical validation.
